statement_map.email_excerpt: You reached out because your customers were not receiving the order confirmation email after they bought, even though you had connected your payment gateway.
Following our guidance, you switched on the order confirmation email for your product and saved it, and after a test order you confirmed the confirmation email arrived in your inbox.
The email still shows the default sender name, which is not yet resolved.
We explained that you can change it under Email settings, then Sender name.
Change the sender name under Email settings, then Sender name, to use your brand name (you mentioned you planned to do this after our call).
